12:12.text: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ.
12:12.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.

12:26.text: If one member suffers, all suffer together; if one member is honored, all rejoice together.
12:26.notes: Agrees with the RSV cache entry unless noted.
